camel_example: aliyun fnf StopExecution --region cn-hangzhou --ExecutionName my_exec_name --FlowName my_flow_name
description_zh: 停止一个正在执行的流程
kebab_example: aliyun fnf stop-execution --flow-name my_flow_name --execution-name my_exec_name --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopExecution

parameters.help_en: The name of the flow to stop. You can obtain the flow name from the response of the ListFlows operation
parameters.help_zh: 需要停止的流程名称，可以通过ListFlows的返回值获取
parameters.name: flow_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the execution to stop. You can obtain the execution name from the response of the ListExecutions operation
parameters.help_zh: 需要停止的执行名称，可以通过ListExecutions的返回值获取
parameters.name: execution_name

parameters.help_en: The cause of the stop error. The value must be 1 to 4,096 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 停止错误原因。长度为1~4096个字符
parameters.name: cause

parameters.help_en: The error code for the stop operation. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 停止错误代码。长度为1~128个字符
parameters.name: error

FlowDefinition.description_en: The flow definition of the execution
FlowDefinition.example:
旧版：
"type: flow
version: v1
name: my_flow_name
steps:
  - type: pass
    name: mypass"

新版：
"Type: StateMachine
SpecVersion: v1
Name: my_flow_name
StartAt: my_state
States:
  - Type: Pass
    Name: my_state
    End: true"

Input.description_en: The input of the execution, in JSON object format
Input.description_zh: 执行的输入，为JSON对象格式

Output.description_en: The output of the execution, in JSON object format
Output.description_zh: 执行的输出，为JSON对象格式

RoleArn.description_en:
The role permission configuration for the execution. If the RoleArn in the flow definition changes during the execution, the system records and returns a snapshot of the RoleArn at the time the execution started.
If no execution role is configured for your flow during execution, this field is not returned
RoleArn.description_zh:
执行的角色权限配置。若流程定义中的RoleArn在执行期间发生变更，系统将记录并返回执行初始时刻的RoleArn的快照。
如果您的流程在执行时未配置执行角色，则该字段不会出现

StartedTime.description_en: The time when the execution started. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ format
StartedTime.description_zh: 执行开始时间，采用 ISO 8601 标准的 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ

Status.description_en:
The execution status. Valid values:
Starting
Running
Stopped
Succeeded
Failed
TimedOut
Status.description_zh:
执行状态。取值说明如下：
Starting
Running
Stopped
Succeeded
Failed
TimedOut

StoppedTime.description_en: The time when the execution was stopped. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ format
StoppedTime.description_zh: 执行停止时间，采用 ISO 8601 标准的 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ
